title: Create case and checklist on offer acceptance
exact_baseline: Auto-create the onboarding case on offer acceptance and instantiate the pre-boarding checklist.
expected_evidence: Case ID, checklist snapshot and audit event
gap_reason: Offer-trigger automation must be observed; intake is implemented.

title: Validate and chase mandatory documents
exact_baseline: Ingest and validate new-hire documents against the mandatory checklist; flag and chase deficiencies.
expected_evidence: Per-file validation, deficiency and audit evidence
gap_reason: Authenticity, scanner and provider proof remain distinct.

title: Initiate and track BGV
exact_baseline: Initiate BGV via vendor API and track status against SLA with automated reminders.
expected_evidence: Correlated provider receipt and SLA reminder
gap_reason: No approved BGV sandbox is configured.

title: Route BGV discrepancy
exact_baseline: Route BGV discrepancies to HR/Compliance with the vendor report for disposition.
gap_reason: Vendor report authenticity and human decision need observation.

title: Create Oracle HCM record
exact_baseline: Create the employee record in Oracle HCM with position, org, manager, and start date on clearance.
gap_reason: Oracle HCM is a target system, not configured integration.

title: Raise IT/asset/access requests
exact_baseline: Auto-raise IT/asset and role-based access requests via the service catalogue.
gap_reason: No approved ITSM sandbox is configured.

title: Configure payroll and benefits
exact_baseline: Configure payroll and benefits enrolment with validation against the HRIS record.
gap_reason: No payroll/benefits sandbox or approved cutoff policy.

title: Maintain five-workstream readiness
exact_baseline: Maintain a live onboarding readiness score across the five workstreams.
gap_reason: Observation is not a live-release approval.

title: Enforce Day-1 BGV checkpoint
exact_baseline: Enforce a Day-1 readiness checkpoint with BGV clearance as a hard prerequisite.
expected_evidence: Gateway C state, BGV and approval evidence
gap_reason: Provider/approval evidence remains governed.

title: Guide induction and compliance learning
exact_baseline: Provide guided Day-1 induction and mandatory compliance-training enrolment.
gap_reason: No configured LMS/induction execution is claimed.

title: Buddy and manager connect
exact_baseline: Assign a buddy and schedule the structured manager connect.
gap_reason: Business activity must be performed and observed.

title: 30/60/90 and probation
exact_baseline: Schedule 30-60-90 check-ins and capture probation confirmation.
gap_reason: No generated completion is represented as proof.

title: SLA breach alert
exact_baseline: Generate real-time alerts when any workstream breaches its SLA relative to the joining date.
gap_reason: Calendar, timezone and holidays remain tenant decisions.

title: Rehire/conversion reduced collection
exact_baseline: Support rehire/conversion with reduced re-collection where prior records are valid.
gap_reason: Prior-record validity is policy/human review dependent.

title: Data minimisation and RBAC
exact_baseline: Enforce data minimisation and role-based access to sensitive new-hire data.
gap_reason: Needs two authorized test roles/tenants.

title: Immutable audit trail
exact_baseline: Maintain an immutable audit trail of steps, approvals, owners, and timestamps.
gap_reason: Audit evidence must be independently inspected.

title: Access/asset prerequisite
exact_baseline: No system access or asset is granted before BGV clearance (or approved conditional join) and active HRIS record.
expected_evidence: Blocked request or approved human exception
gap_reason: HRIS/provider activation is absent; conditional join disabled pending policy.

title: Version-controlled templates
exact_baseline: Onboarding checklists and role-based access templates are version-controlled; only HR Operations/IT owners may modify them.
gap_reason: Authorized configuration fixture required.

title: Need-to-know sensitive data
exact_baseline: Sensitive new-hire data is collected on a minimisation basis and accessible only on a role-based need-to-know.
gap_reason: Role/tenant observation required.

title: Day-1 workstream gate
exact_baseline: Day-1 readiness requires all mandatory workstreams complete or approved contingency, with BGV as hard prerequisite.
gap_reason: Live approval/provider evidence is not simulated.

title: Human BGV disposition
exact_baseline: BGV discrepancies are dispositioned only by HR/Compliance; analysts cannot self-approve adverse results.
gap_reason: Human authority must be independently valid.

title: Decision/provisioning audit
exact_baseline: Every onboarding decision, approval, and provisioning action is logged with owner and timestamp for audit.
gap_reason: External provisioning action cannot be claimed without source receipt.

title: Bounded reversible agents
exact_baseline: Agent actions are bounded and reversible; defined checkpoints require human approval before proceeding.
gap_reason: No agent output authorizes sensitive action.

title: Retention and external sharing
exact_baseline: Records are retained per statutory policy; documents are not shared externally.
expected_evidence: Retention/hold state and denied external action
gap_reason: No tenant retention policy value is assumed.

title: Frontline intake context
exact_baseline: Capture role, site, shift, and skill category for frontline intake.
gap_reason: Observation required.

title: Eligibility evidence
exact_baseline: Require ID, age proof and applicable skill/trade evidence before regulated deployment.
gap_reason: Authenticity not verified locally.

title: Police verification applicability
exact_baseline: Perform police verification only where policy and lawful applicability require it.
gap_reason: No jurisdiction policy or sandbox.

title: Medical fitness
exact_baseline: Require medical fitness evidence before floor/site deployment.
gap_reason: Simulated result is not medical evidence.

title: Drug-test applicability
exact_baseline: Require drug-test evidence only where policy and lawful applicability require it.
gap_reason: No lawful applicability default.

title: BGV and fitness review
exact_baseline: Require medically-fit and BGV-clear outcomes; route failures to HR/OH review.
gap_reason: Human disposition/provider evidence required.

title: Statutory IDs
exact_baseline: Record statutory worker IDs only where applicable before first wage processing.
gap_reason: No configured payroll sandbox.

title: Physical provisioning
exact_baseline: Issue and record badge, PPE, uniform, tools and locker prerequisites before floor access.
gap_reason: Actual store issuance needs observation.

title: Wage/timesheet setup
exact_baseline: Use wage/timesheet setup and applicable statutory payroll registration.
gap_reason: Provider not configured.

title: Safety induction gate
exact_baseline: Require safety induction and competency sign-off before floor/site access.
gap_reason: Human safety sign-off required.

title: PPE/emergency data minimisation
exact_baseline: Capture PPE size and next-of-kin/emergency-contact data only through an approved, minimised process.
gap_reason: No approved process represented.

title: Applicable labour obligations
exact_baseline: Apply age, labour, wage/hour, social-security and contractor-labour obligations only after jurisdiction/contract review.
gap_reason: No legal default.

title: Frontline records/audit
exact_baseline: Retain PPE issuance, safety sign-off, fitness certificates and IDs as auditable evidence.
gap_reason: Retention policy needs approval.

title: Independent safety/medical gates
exact_baseline: Keep medical/safety hard gates independent of weighted readiness score.
gap_reason: Observed simulated state only.

title: Frontline exceptions
exact_baseline: Handle restriction, failed competency, PPE stock-out, missing evidence and surge intake without release.
gap_reason: No live floor release.

title: Assisted intake/right to work
exact_baseline: Support assisted site intake for low-literacy workers and verify applicable right-to-work evidence before deployment.
gap_reason: No assisted/right-to-work verifier.

title: Frontline supervision/early tenure
exact_baseline: Assign supervisor/buddy, record OJT or machine-SOP training and probation confirmation.
gap_reason: No execution claimed.

title: Site welfare
exact_baseline: Manage transport and canteen enrolment where site welfare services are provided.
gap_reason: Conditional service is not implemented.

title: Minimum age gate
exact_baseline: Verify minimum working age and block under-age deployment before regulated floor/site release.
gap_reason: Identity verification remains unavailable.

title: Frontline metrics
exact_baseline: Track frontline cycle-time, medical turnaround, safety, PPE, statutory and early-attrition measures as reviewable policy metrics.
gap_reason: No all-metric implementation claim.

title: Separate frontline workstreams
exact_baseline: Evaluate documentation, BGV/police, medical/drug, provisioning, payroll and HSE separately, with hard gates.
gap_reason: Simulated assessment only.

title: Frontline RACI
exact_baseline: Assign and preserve frontline RACI responsibilities for intake, verification, medical, provisioning, payroll, safety and OJT.
gap_reason: RACI execution needs business configuration.

title: Transfer due diligence
exact_baseline: Perform secure HR due diligence over headcount, terms, service and liabilities.
gap_reason: Secure due diligence is human/legal governed.

title: Transfer basis
exact_baseline: Determine transfer basis and applicable law before selecting a transfer pathway.
gap_reason: No automated legal conclusion.

title: Consultation
exact_baseline: Complete required representative/works-council consultation on the applicable statutory timeline.
gap_reason: No jurisdiction timeline default.

title: Transfer communications
exact_baseline: Issue individual transfer communications and measures information after legal review.
gap_reason: No authorized live dispatch.

title: Objections and terms
exact_baseline: Handle objections, opt-outs, redundancy and terms changes under applicable law and approved policy.
gap_reason: No legal/policy decision inferred.

title: Bulk migration/service continuity
exact_baseline: Bulk-create transfer records while preserving validated original hire/service dates.
gap_reason: External HRIS creation unavailable.

title: Legal Day-1 cutover
exact_baseline: Cut over payroll, benefits and access at legal Day-1 with no unreviewed pay-disruption release.
gap_reason: No provider sandbox.

title: Cutover contingency
exact_baseline: Use a legally reviewed contingency for failed transfer cutover and preserve evidence.
gap_reason: Legal review still required.

title: Integration and harmonisation
exact_baseline: Deliver transfer integration induction and approved post-transfer harmonisation.
gap_reason: No harmonisation execution claim.

title: Transfer data/pension privacy
exact_baseline: Lawfully minimise and secure seller employee data and address applicable pension/benefit obligations.
gap_reason: No legal/pension default.

title: Transfer stabilisation metrics
exact_baseline: Confirm workforce stabilisation and track Day-1 pay, migration, consultation, access, attrition and harmonisation measures.
gap_reason: No all-metric implementation claim.

title: Transfer RACI
exact_baseline: Assign and preserve transfer RACI responsibilities for due diligence, basis, consultation, communications, objections, migration, cutover and harmonisation.
gap_reason: Authority and business execution must be observed.

title: Twelve-step lifecycle
exact_baseline: Operate the 12-step backbone from intake through documents, BGV, HRIS, provisioning, payroll, Day-1, induction, buddy and probation.
gap_reason: HRIS, provider, induction and early-tenure execution are not all configured.

title: Five-workstream SLA model
exact_baseline: Track Documentation, BGV, HRIS, IT & assets and Payroll & benefits by joining-date SLA and use the stated 20/25/15/20/20 readiness weights as provisional baseline.
gap_reason: Calendar/timezone and targets remain provisional governance decisions.

title: No response to deficiency
exact_baseline: After a documentation deficiency notice, lapse/escalate no response under SLA and allow joining-date re-plan.
expected_evidence: Deficiency, elapsed clock and escalation evidence
gap_reason: Actual communication delivery/monitoring requires approved path.

title: Delayed BGV
exact_baseline: When BGV exceeds the acceptable window, use an approved conditional join where permitted or defer the start date.
gap_reason: Conditional join is disabled pending approved tenant policy; vendor sandbox absent.

title: IT/asset Day-1 contingency
exact_baseline: When IT/assets are not provisioned before Day-1, expose manual expedite, interim access or contingency plan rather than silently release.
gap_reason: No configured ITSM sandbox or live effect.

title: Payroll cutoff recovery
exact_baseline: When payroll cut-off is missed, record off-cycle payment or next-cycle correction through accountable payroll handling.
gap_reason: No approved payroll-cutoff value or sandbox.

title: Start-date change resequencing
exact_baseline: On start-date changes after setup, update effective date and re-sequence provisioning.
expected_evidence: Date-change, affected task and audit record
gap_reason: Requires observed permitted change workflow.

title: Duplicate and rehire conflict
exact_baseline: Use master-data check to prevent duplicate employee record and reactivate prior record where appropriate.
gap_reason: External master record operation is unavailable.

title: Bulk-volume recovery
exact_baseline: Use cohort batch checklist and additional analyst assignment during campus/bulk intake spike.
gap_reason: Capacity and assignment require observed environment.

title: Lateral hire
exact_baseline: Apply complete documentation, standard BGV and role-based access for lateral/experienced hire.
gap_reason: Provider/configured access proof unavailable.

title: Campus/fresher cohort
exact_baseline: Use common-start cohort onboarding with batch collection, standardised induction and bulk provisioning.
gap_reason: Induction/provisioning execution is not configured.

title: Rehire/conversion
exact_baseline: Use expedited policy-controlled re-collection with refreshed BGV/access and HRBP eligibility review.
gap_reason: Policy validity and source-system reactivation need review.

title: Cross-border/relocation
exact_baseline: Add visa/work-authorization, jurisdiction forms and localized payroll/benefits with Legal/Mobility involvement.
gap_reason: No jurisdiction, immigration or payroll default is approved.

title: Executive/senior hire
exact_baseline: Apply enhanced due diligence, confidentiality handling, tailored induction and executive asset provisioning.
gap_reason: Bespoke executive handling is not automated.

title: Core RACI ownership
exact_baseline: Preserve accountable ownership for intake, documents, BGV, HRIS, IT, payroll, readiness, induction, buddy and probation activities.
gap_reason: Observed roles may vary by tenant.

title: Application landscape boundary
exact_baseline: Use Oracle HCM, ServiceNow HRSD, BGV vendor, ITSM, payroll/benefits, Outlook/Teams and Power BI as named system roles without claiming unconfigured integrations.
gap_reason: Named landscape is not proof of configured integration.

title: Core onboarding measures
exact_baseline: Review cycle time, Day-1 readiness, document completeness, BGV turnaround and provisioning-on-time measures; targets remain pending To-Be design.
gap_reason: Synthetic outcomes are not KPI proof; targets are provisional.

title: Experience and early-tenure measures
exact_baseline: Review new-hire eNPS and 0–90-day attrition measures without using analytics for individual employment judgment.
gap_reason: No individual-identifying or sensitive analytics.

title: Source labels and To-Be status
exact_baseline: Preserve Draft for Review source labels and treat grey To-Be content as pending design confirmation rather than SME-approved production policy.
gap_reason: Conflicting labels and unresolved decisions remain open.

title: Test Center access and execution
exact_baseline: Authorized users select scenarios, receive role instructions, create/pause/resume/rerun runs and retain versioned history.
expected_evidence: Run version, actor steps and history
gap_reason: Rerun/run persistence must be observed.

title: Fixtures and evidence export
exact_baseline: Fixture download and redacted step/evidence report distinguish inputs from observed local parse/content-rule outcomes and from scanner, authenticity or provider evidence; reports preserve result provenance without fabricating backend evidence.
expected_evidence: Fixture manifest, local-result provenance and report export
gap_reason: Fixtures are inputs, not auto-verified negative outcomes; scanner/authenticity evidence is separately observed.

title: Run-scoped evaluator boundary
exact_baseline: The run-owned evaluator may invoke actual production pure predicates only against run-owned fixture/snapshot state; it must not dispatch providers or mutate real cases, readiness, global time, credentials, leases or real deadlines.
expected_evidence: Run evaluator, predicate-result provenance, exchange/clock history and no-dispatch boundary
gap_reason: Provider sandbox is separately blocked; real-case readiness mutations are prohibited.

title: Scoped cleanup and isolation
exact_baseline: Cleanup removes only run-owned UAT state and respects tenant isolation, retention and holds.
gap_reason: Requires two authorized test organizations for full observation.
